=timeout 60 docker exec linkfinder python /app/linkfinder.py -i "{{ $json.target }}" -d -o cli > /tmp/lf_out.txt 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; cp /tmp/lf_out.txt "{{ $json.linkfinderOut }}" 2>/dev/null; echo "DONE"

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg = $input.first().json;
const fs = require('fs');

const discovery = {
  runId: cfg.runId,
  target: cfg.target,
  vulnType: cfg.vulnType,
  depth: cfg.depth,
  authToken: cfg.authToken,
  wordlist: cfg.wordlist,
  baseUrl: cfg.baseUrl,
  openApiUrl: cfg.openApiUrl,
  baselineUrl: cfg.baselineUrl,
  ts: cfg.ts,
  slug: cfg.slug,

  endpoints: cfg.endpoints,
  endpointCount: cfg.endpointCount,
  puppeteerForms: cfg.puppeteerForms || [],

  // пути ко всем файлам
  configFile:      cfg.configFile,
  baselineFile:    cfg.baselineFile,
  endpointsFile:   cfg.endpointsFile,
  arjunFile:       cfg.arjunFile,
  dictResultsFile: cfg.dictResultsFile,
  schemaResultsFile: cfg.schemaResultsFile,
  reportFile:      cfg.reportFile,
  katanaOut:       cfg.katanaOut,
  linkfinderOut:   cfg.linkfinderOut,
  puppeteerOut:    cfg.puppeteerOut,
  schemathesisOut: cfg.schemathesisOut,

  owaspCategory: cfg.owaspCategory,
  owaspName: cfg.owaspName,
  startTime: cfg.startTime,
};

fs.writeFileSync(cfg.endpointsFile, JSON.stringify(discovery, null, 2));
console.log(`Workflow 1 DONE. Endpoints: ${discovery.endpointCount}, file: ${cfg.endpointsFile}`);

return [{ json: discovery }];
